newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Jardine Fleming plans 9.1 percent buyback.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Fleming plans 9.1 percent buyback.

text.p: New Zealand listed fund Jardine Fleming China Region Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to buy back 9.1 percent of the company.
It said it intended to conduct an on-market buy back of its shares over a six month period commencing on April 22 and concluding on October 21.
The maximum number of shares that the company intends to buy this way is 6,384,351.
The company said it was aiming to reduce the discount to net tangible asset backing at which the company's shares have traded.
At March 31 this discount was estimated at 24.7 percent which the directors regarded as excessive given the recent trading performance of the company.
The shares were up one cent at 73 cents on market.
